hints.content:
The slope of  the graph of $A =-4-0.6t$ represents the rate of change of Mr. Mole's altitude. Since the formula for $A$ is in *slope-intercept form*, we can determine that the slope is $\green{-0.6}$. The slope is *negative* because each additional minute resulted in a *decrease* of $0.6$ meters in Mr. Mole's altitude. He decreased in altitude because he dug that far into the ground. This means that Mr. Mole dug at a rate of $\green{0.6}$ meters per minute.

The table of values for Bugs Bunny shows that for each increase of $\blue{\text{time}}$ by $\blue 7$ minutes, $\pink{\text{altitude}}$ decreased by $\pink{5.6}$ meters. The rate at which he changed altitude is the ratio of the corresponding differences in $\pink{\text{altitude}}$ and $\blue{\text{time}}$:

$\dfrac{\Delta \pink{\text{altitude}}}{\Delta \blue{\text{time}}}=\dfrac{-5.6}{7}=\green{-0.8}$

Bugs Bunny decreased in altitude because he was digging. This means that Bugs Bunny dug at a rate of $\green{0.8}$ meters per minute.

**Since $\green{0.6}<\green{0.8}$, Bugs Bunny dug faster.**

The starting altitude of Mr. Mole corresponds to the value of $A$ when $t=0$. To find it, all we need is to substitute $\blue t=\blue 0$ into the formula for $A$:

$\begin{align}
 A &=-4-0.6\blue t \\\\
&=-4-0.6\cdot\blue 0 \\\\
&=\pink{-4}
\end{align}$

This means that Mr. Mole started at an altitude of $\pink{-4}$ meters, which is $\pink{4}$ meters below the ground.

We can extend the table of Bugs Bunny according to the rate of change we found to find the value of $\pink{\text{altitude}}$ when $\blue{\text{time}}$ was $\blue 0$ minutes:  
 

[[☃ image 1]]

This means that Bugs Bunny started at an altitude of $\pink{0}$ meters, which is ground level.

**Since $\pink{-4}<\pink{0}$, Bugs Bunny started at a higher altitude.**

question.content:
Mr. Mole and Bugs Bunny started digging their way into the ground from different locations at the same time. They each dug at a constant rate.

The following equation gives Mr. Mole's altitude (in meters relative to the ground) as a function of time (in minutes).

$A =-4-0.6t$

Bugs Bunny's altitude (in meters relative to the ground) as a function of time (in minutes) is given by the following table of values:

$\text{Time}$ (minutes) | $\text{Altitude}$ (meters)
:-: | :-:
$2$ | $-1.6$
$9$ | $-7.2$
$16$ | $-12.8$

**Who dug faster?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

**Who started at a higher altitude?**

[[☃ radio 2]]

choices.content: They both dug at the same rate
They both started at the same altitude
